results.summary: Key flashpoints: US-Iran conflict escalating (Strait of Hormuz threat, UAE missile intercepts); US capture of Venezuelan President Maduro; NATO posture in Greenland. May 4: S&P 500 -0.41%, Dow -1.13%, Nasdaq -0.19% on escalation. WTI at ~$106 on May 4, eased to $104.10 on May 5. Tariff uncertainty + Fed leadership transition + midterms add to investor uncertainty.
